seo.title: On-premises deployment
seo.seo_title: On-premises AI server for small businesses
seo.seo_description: Nexora installs the AI system on your server, in your offices or at a host of your choice. Hardware and access are yours; outbound flows are listed in writing.

translation.headline: AI on your server. The access is yours.
translation.subheadline: We install and configure the system on a server you own, in your offices or at a host of your choice. What leaves your network, if anything, is handed to you in writing before go-live.

blocks.role: Périmètre sur place : schéma et liste de ce qui reste dedans et de ce qui peut sortir.

translation.title: The perimeter, on your premises.
translation.body: The diagram shows a typical perimeter: your server, your workstations, your documents. It is an example, not a real customer's configuration; the diagram for your installation is handed over in writing.

items.title: What stays within your walls.
items.text: Documents, the search index, conversations, logs and, if you choose, the models.

items.title: What may leave.
items.text: Updates, licence checks, and an external model only if you accepted it in writing.

items.title: What we verify.
items.text: Every outbound flow is listed. We write “no data leaves” only if we have checked it on your configuration.

blocks.role: Étapes de la mise en place sur place.

cards.title: Size.
cards.text: The diagnosis measures your uses and sets the hardware needed, before any purchase.

cards.title: Install.
cards.text: Installation is one command on a Docker server (a tool that packages software), on Linux or macOS.

cards.title: Configure.
cards.text: Accounts, roles, single sign-on with your identity provider, model, connections to your software.

cards.title: Verify.
cards.text: List of outbound flows, diagram handed over in writing, test of a real case.

cards.title: Train.
cards.text: Usage and supervision, for your team.

cards.title: Operate.
cards.text: Division of tasks written in the contract: updates, backups, monitoring.

blocks.role: Qui fait quoi dans le mode sur place.

cards.title: You.
cards.text:
You own the hardware.
You hold the access and grant it to Nexora as needed.
You place and keep the backups.
You decide on the models and any external option.

cards.title: Nexora.
cards.text:
We size, install and configure.
We list the outbound flows and hand over the diagram.
We train your team.
We run it with you, as the contract provides.

cards.title: Offline is not presumed.
cards.text: A server on your premises can still receive updates or check a licence. Everything is listed.

cards.title: The hardware has to keep up.
cards.text: A model on your server needs suitable hardware. A small local model is not always enough for agents that call tools.

cards.title: No announced service level.
cards.text: Availability and response times are set out in the contract.

cards.title: Hardware is sized before it is bought.
cards.text: No standard configuration: it depends on the number of users, the volume of documents and the model.

blocks.role: FAQ propre au mode sur place.

items.question: Does my data stay with me?
items.answer: Documents, the index and conversations stay on your server. The only outbound flows are those we list together: updates, licences, and an external model if you choose one.

items.question: Does Nexora access my server?
items.answer: Only through the access you grant, agreed in advance. You can withdraw it.

items.question: Can I install it at a host of my choice?
items.answer: Yes: “on your premises” means on a server you own, in your offices or at the host you choose. Its location then appears on the data-flow diagram.

items.question: What if I want to leave?
items.answer: You keep your server, your documents, your configurations and your workflows: export is provided for in the contract.

translation.title: Let's study your server.
translation.text: Tell us your uses and constraints. We will tell you what would need to be installed, where, and what would leave the network.
